zh: 下载结束后没有必要关掉计算机。
en: There is no need to turn off the computer after the download ends.

zh: 你必须关闭浏览器，但是不必关闭计算机。
en: You must close the browser, but you do not need to turn off the computer.

zh: 完成截图以后，无需退出程序。
en: There is no need to exit the program after taking the screenshot.

zh: 文件已经保存，你不需要再保存一次。
en: The file is already saved. You do not need to save it again.

zh: 重启之前一定要保存，但不必删除备份。
en: You must save before restarting, but you do not need to delete the backup.

zh: 此时无需断电，保持系统运行即可。
en: There is no need to disconnect the power now. Just keep the system running.

zh: 故障修好后可以断开电源，但这不是必须的。
en: You can disconnect the power supply after the fault is fixed, but it is not required.

zh: 请不要退出应用程序，否则修改将丢失。
en: Do not exit the application, or your changes will be lost.

zh: 如果进度未达到100%，禁止关机。
en: Do not shut down if progress has not reached 100%.

zh: 读取磁盘时不能拔掉电源。
en: Do not unplug the power supply while reading the disk.

zh: 先关闭文本编辑器，再关闭笔记本电脑。
en: Close the text editor first, then turn off the laptop.

zh: 每次检测的收费为315元人民币。
这件商品的标价是87欧元，税已包含在内。
en: The listed price of this item is 87 euros, including tax.

zh: 这份报价只有税前金额，尚未包含税费。
en: This quote only gives the pre-tax amount and does not yet include taxes.

zh: 免税与未含税是两回事。
en: Tax-exempt and tax-exclusive are two different things.

zh: 付款未成功，不要重复提交订单。
en: The payment was unsuccessful. Do not submit the order again.
